主要内容: Nordic American Tankers Ltd (NAT) secured a $306 million five-year senior secured credit agreement on February 12, 2019, arranged by CSG Investments, Inc., and funded by Beal Bank. The loan will retire its existing Revolving Credit Facility and reduce the effective interest rate compared to 2018. The loan amortizes over 20 years with full maturity after five years. NAT also leased three 2018 new buildings to settle major financial obligations. The company maintains low debt levels and aims to reduce them further. Its Suezmaxes market remains strong, and the recent plan supports future growth. Arctic Securities assisted in the transaction. NAT issued a cautionary statement on forward-looking statements, noting uncertainties and risks associated with future performance, including market conditions, charter rates, vessel values, and regulatory changes.
